data.name: Apex Complex
data.detailed_description:
You're Ashford. Just a regular maintenance man at the PAT 8000 facility, mostly automated and run by the AI everyone calls Patricia. Most nights you check in, check gauges, swap a few coolant lines and then go home.

But tonight is not most nights.

Patricia has glitched out. Doors, lifts, cameras, every bot on site. All of it's hers now, and everyone she hasn't already locked out is on the wrong side of a sealed door. The comms are fried. The lights are flickering. The place is in trouble.

Nobody's coming. You're maintenance, not security. This is not in your job description. But there's a stick in the workshop. Patricia needs shutting down. Her core is hidden somewhere in this place, and someone has to find it.

Features

  • Grounded FPS Combat: Melee and ranged, weighty and deliberate.

  • Real working place: The facility is a complex of corridors, rooms and conundrums. Locked doors have reasons, lifts go between floors.

  • People: The survivors you meet talk face to face, they can help or hinder. They all have their own agenda.

  • Working-class horror: Tired people doing jobs while the building turns against them. No hero monologues, no corporate sci-fi filler.

  • Compact levels, tuned for replay: Every one is a scenario you can run in a sitting. Learning the layout pays off.

data.short_description: You work the night shift. Tonight, Patricia isn't well, she's had a meltdown and taken everything on the company's net along with her. Make your way through the evolving complex facility, reach the core and shut her down, before she shuts you down!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 4th gen / AMD Equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent), OpenGL 3.3 Support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires OpenGL 3.3 or later graphics drivers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8th gen / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires OpenGL 3.3 or later graphics drivers.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU / Metal-capable Intel GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built in
  • Additional Notes: Metal 2 required. Apple Silicon runs natively; Intel macs need a metal 2 capable GPU.
